title: Thrackle-style conjecture for almost holey convex families
statement:
Suppose that $d4c2$ is a set of $n$ points in the plane, and let $S_1,cdots,S_m\subseteq d4c2$ be subsets with convex hulls

$$
C_i=\operatorname{conv}(S_i).
$$

Assume that $1<|S_i|<n$ for every $i$, that $C_i\cap C_j\ne\emptyset$ whenever $i\ne j$, and that

$$
C_i\cap C_j\cap C_k\subseteq d4c2
$$

whenever $i\ne j\ne k\ne i$. **Thrackle-style conjecture for almost holey convex families.** Under these assumptions, $m\le n$. This is posed as an open problem for families of pairwise-intersecting convex hulls whose triple intersections contain only the given points; the paper does not provide a resolution.
source_name: Péter Ágoston, Gábor Damásdi, Balázs Keszegh and Dömötör Pálvölgyi, “Orientation of convex sets”, arXiv:2206.01721 (2024).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.01721

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2022).
